Thirumavalavan dismisses PMK-TVK alliance rumors, calls it VCK confusion tactic

Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) president Thol. Thirumavalavan has stated that rumors of the Pattali Makkal Katchi (PMK) joining hands with the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) are intended to confuse VCK cadres. Thirumavalavan also described his party's decision to ally with TVK as an "order of the times", suggesting it was an opportune moment for VCK to share power. He further commented that even with a majority, the BJP gives ministerial posts to smaller parties.
